_comment: WORKING LAB CONFIGURATION -- Automatrix PV-DG Controller.
Points the controller at the SolTrix Modbus simulator so the control loop can
be exercised end to end without touching a real inverter. Every value here is
either measured against that simulator or a firmware default; nothing is a
guess about site equipment.
This configures a LAB target. The controller will report
commissioning_scope = lab_simulator_only and lab_simulator_mode = true, and
nothing observed while running it is evidence about physical equipment.
Apply with docs/SAMPLE_CONFIGURATION.md; the sections map to separate
authenticated endpoints and cannot be posted as one document.

meters._comment: The simulated EM500. Its map matches the real meter: FC03, PDU 57, signed int32, high word first, 1e-5 kW per raw unit.
meters.name: LAB SIM EM500
meters._data_type_meaning: 0 uint16, 1 int16, 2 uint32, 3 int32, 4 float32 -- int32 is REQUIRED because grid power is negative when exporting
meters._poll_ms_meaning: 0 = issue the next read as soon as the previous transaction completes. Any positive value is honoured exactly, for a device or gateway that cannot sustain the rate.
meters._timeout_meaning: Measured on the real gateway: mean 93 ms, max 319 ms. 300 ms sat inside that tail and marked ~3% of good reads as failures. See docs/ACQUISITION_TIMING_MEASUREMENTS.md.

inverters._comment: The simulated Huawei-layout inverter, unit 1 on the same simulator.
inverters.name: LAB SIM HUAWEI

_comment: soltrix.sim.huawei.v3 was measured against this simulator, not copied from a
manual. It declares a 2500 ms settle window because the simulator applies a
40125 write about 1500 ms later and reports the PREVIOUS limit until it does.
The older v1 profile probes 40000/40010, which this simulator does not
implement, so it would simply fail.
lab_target = true is what unlocks commanding through a profile that has not
passed physical qualification. It grants LAB authority only, never production,
and it disables automatic control when set so it cannot take effect under a
running loop -- re-enable control afterwards.
LAB values for the simulator's modelled plant (70 kW load, 100 kW PV, no
generator running). These are NOT site data and must not be copied to a real
plant -- the site template leaves them blank on purpose.
interval_ms is FIXED and fast, deliberately not poll-on-completion like
acquisition: a jittering control period gives a jittering integral term, and
determinism is worth more here than the last few milliseconds. Commands are
issued on change plus a keepalive, so a fast loop does not mean fast writes.
grid_ramp disabled = reach the allowed target in ONE cycle, which is the
grid-mode requirement. It removes a rate limit only; the export/import
target, the generator minimum-loading limit and every safety clamp still
apply. generator_ramp is a true rate in percent of fleet capacity per second,
independent of the loop period, with the down rate faster than the up rate
because reducing PV is the direction that protects the generator.
control._enabled_comment: Left FALSE. Enable only after the commissioning gate reports satisfied and you have read its scope.
